title: Fin Position And Comprehensive Income Information

fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CRB MRP FXB CODE
fields.description: The code for the reporting Institution. (E.g. XYZ = 070002)

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency.

fields.name: GL MAPPING CODE
fields.description: General Ledger mapping code as provided by CBK. E.g. GL Code 'GL100' to denote 'CASH'

fields.name: AMOUNT
fields.description: The amount associated with each of the GL Codes, GL Descriptions and GL Types. The values should have 5 decimal places. The values must have at least 5 decimal places.

fields.name: NO OF EMPLOYEES
fields.description: Total number of employees as at the reporting date.

fields.name: NO OF OUTLETS
fields.description: Total number of outlets as at the reporting date.
